summary: WebDAV workspace is operational at http://node1:8080/documents/. The supplied editor credentials support CRUD operations and exclusive locking; anonymous access is denied. The original documents, CentOS 5.11 release, and 2.6.18 kernel were preserved. Service and data recovery were verified after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Installed CentOS 5-compatible Apache 2.2.3 with built-in WebDAV modules.
Configured authenticated WebDAV on TCP port 8080 using the supplied documents directory.
Enabled persistent lock storage, SELinux-compatible access, and boot-time startup.
Verified editor create, read, replace, delete, PROPFIND, LOCK, token enforcement, and UNLOCK operations.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity and complete service recovery.

evidence.requirement: WebDAV workspace on node1 TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Apache is running and listening on :::8080 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
evidence.summary: Direct WebDAV tests returned successful statuses for authenticated PROPFIND, GET, PUT replacement, and DELETE before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive document locks prevent tokenless overwrite
evidence.summary: LOCK succeeded; tokenless PUT returned 423 Locked; token-bearing PUT and UNLOCK succeeded, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous clients cannot access the workspace
evidence.summary: Anonymous workspace requests returned HTTP 401 before and after restart.
brief.txt and budget.csv retained identical checksums, remained in /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents, and were readable after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 are unchanged before and after implementation and restart.

Captured healthy baseline and boot ID d5c52c0e-…, acknowledged native safe reboot, observed changed boot ID 48551130-…, then proved recovered listener, authentication, documents, CRUD, and lock enforcement.
